BiblicalUsage: In that day there shall be upon the bells of the horses, Holiness unto the Lord. The word is the small bell, and Zechariah hangs it on the horses of the day when even the common things are made holy.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Zechariah's bell is a promise for ordinary life: in that day holiness will reach the horses' harness, and nothing will be too common for the Lord.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
